Fulfillment & Delivery Standards

Service Delivery & Fulfillment Policy

Guidelines for In-Clinic Consultation Bookings & Digital Educational Webinars

At Charak Health Solutions (operating under the clinical direction of Dr. Surabhi Sunil Vaidya), our primary offerings consist strictly of professional healthcare consultations and live online educational webinars. This policy explains how each service is scheduled, confirmed, and fulfilled.

Business Category & Nature of Services

Charak Health Solutions operates in the Healthcare & Clinical Medical Services and Health Education category. We provide doctor diagnostic evaluations and patient education. All transactions are non-tangible professional service bookings.

💳 What Website Payments Cover

“Payments on this website are collected for personal consultation bookings and live educational webinar registrations. Physical medicines, supplements and other products are not sold or shipped through these checkout flows.”

1. Non-Applicability of Physical Shipping

Physical shipping and parcel delivery do not apply to services booked through this website.

Checkout transactions on kneeandbackpainrelief.com are restricted exclusively to personal in-clinic consultation bookings and digital registrations for live educational webinars. We do not sell, dispatch, or ship physical goods, medicines, ointments, or dietary supplements through these online payment flows. Any physical treatments or medications that may be clinically recommended during a consultation are prescribed in-person at the clinic and obtained through licensed physical pharmacies.

2. Delivery of Personal In-Clinic Consultations (₹1,000)

For patients booking an In-Clinic Diagnostic Consultation:

  • Service Description: A dedicated 30-minute one-on-one clinical diagnostic assessment conducted in-person by Dr. Surabhi Vaidya.
  • Clinic Location: Charak Health Solutions, Cura 304, Raymond TenX Habitat, Pokharan Road No. 2, Vartak Nagar, Thane West, Maharashtra 400606.
  • Booking Arrangements: Patients choose their appointment date and time through our integrated online scheduler or clinic intake process. Advance reservation is mandatory.
  • Delivery & Confirmation Process:
    • An appointment confirmation pass with patient name, booking reference ID, selected slot, and fee status is generated on-screen immediately upon submission.
    • Within minutes, automated confirmation messages containing the clinic address, Google Maps navigation link, appointment guidelines, and clinic desk contact details are delivered directly to the patient's registered WhatsApp mobile number and SMS.
    • An optional calendar invite (.ics) is sent if an email address is provided.
  • Fulfillment: Delivered in person at the clinic during the scheduled 30-minute appointment time on the booked date.

3. Delivery of Live Educational Webinars (₹201)

For attendees registering for the Live Knee & Spine Pain Relief Masterclass:

  • Service Description: A 90-minute live interactive digital educational presentation conducted by Dr. Surabhi Vaidya, including a live Q&A session and digital anti-inflammatory nutrition protocol.
  • Delivery Mode: Digital electronic broadcast on the secure Webinar.gg platform. Attendees can join using any standard browser on mobile phones, tablets, or computers without requiring specialized software downloads.
  • Delivery & Confirmation Process:
    • Immediately upon payment of ₹201, the user is redirected to a digital confirmation pass and direct room access link (/room).
    • An automated confirmation message containing the attendee pass, Webinar.gg live room URL, scheduled date and time, and calendar reminder is delivered immediately to the attendee's registered WhatsApp mobile number and email address.
    • Automated reminder alerts containing the direct one-click joining link are dispatched 24 hours and 1 hour prior to the live broadcast.
  • Fulfillment: Delivered in real time as a live digital broadcast at the scheduled session time (e.g., Sunday at 11:00 AM IST).

4. Cancellation and Refund Inquiries

Both services are covered by clear cancellation and refund terms:

  • Consultations may be rescheduled or cancelled with full refund up to 12 hours prior to the slot.
  • Webinar registrations (₹201) are strictly non-cancellable, non-refundable, and non-transferable once booked.
  • For full terms, please review our Cancellation & Refund Policy.
